agentFiles.change: a new file: what agents do before they push

edits.diff:
--- a/.github/workflows/ci.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
@@ -6,9 +6,13 @@
 jobs:
   test:
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    permissions:
+      contents: read
+      id-token: write
     steps:
       - uses: actions/checkout@v5
-      - run: dotnet test --collect:"XPlat Code Coverage"
+      - uses: hushrun/hushrun/action/setup@v<version>
+      - run: hushrun run test -- dotnet test --collect:"XPlat Code Coverage"
       - uses: danielpalme/ReportGenerator-GitHub-Action@5
         with:
           reports: '**/coverage.cobertura.xml'

--- /dev/null
+++ b/hushrun.yaml
@@ -0,0 +1,4 @@
+# hushrun.yaml: where this repository's events go.
+version: 1
+repository: github.com/acme/shop
+backend: <your org's URL, once you sign in>

commands.after: hushrun run test -- dotnet test --collect:XPlat Code Coverage
commands.ciText: a later step reads its reports (danielpalme/ReportGenerator-GitHub-Action), and a skip writes none

notes: your org: connects github.com/acme/shop, so that its CI records results with its own ID token
your org: adds github.com/acme/shop to your org's dashboard, unless it is there already
hushrun.yaml: a new file: repository github.com/acme/shop, its URL on hushrun, and the key that verifies hushrun's log
CI runs test every time: a later step reads its reports (danielpalme/ReportGenerator-GitHub-Action). Laptops and agents skip it on a pass.
